# RTL plugin

Unchanged @mapbox/mapbox-gl-rtl-text 0.3.0 distribution, BSD-2-Clause.
The .mjs copy is byte-identical to upstream .js and lets MapLibre module workers
import directly under CSP without evaluating script source or allowing unsafe-eval.
